documents.sourceText:
# Board3D.gd
# 军旗翻翻棋 3D · 三维棋盘
#
# 结构：
#   * 木质底板（BoxMesh，顶面 y = 0）；
#   * 棋盘画面（BoardArt 在 SubViewport 里画好，作为贴图铺在底板上方 2mm）；
#   * 选中框 / 悬停框（回字形方框）与可落子标记（发光圆环）。
#
# 棋盘几何全部来自 JunqiMap：COL_X / CELL_Z / MID_PITCH 决定格点位置，
# 因此二维版那张棋盘图里的兵站、行营、铁路比例都被完整保留，只是放大成了三维实体。
#
# 遵循 Godot 4.7 GDScript 2.0 静态类型规范

class_name Board3D
extends Node3D

## 棋盘贴图分辨率（像素 / 世界单位）
const PPU: float = 200.0

const COL_GOLD := Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.30)
const COL_HOVER := Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.55)
const COL_TARGET := Color(0.30, 1.0, 0.45)

## 选中 / 悬停框的外框尺寸
const FRAME_SIZE := Vector2(JunqiMap.CELL_X * 0.96, JunqiMap.CELL_Z * 0.96)

var _art_view: SubViewport = null
var _art: BoardArt = null
var _art_frames: int = 0

var _sel_frame: MeshInstance3D = null
var _hover_frame: MeshInstance3D = null

var _target_mesh: Mesh = null
var _targets_root: Node3D = null
var _targets: Array[MeshInstance3D] = []

var _pulse: float = 0.0


# ==================== 搭建 ====================

func build(font: Font) -> void:
	var bsize: Vector2 = JunqiMap.board_size()
	_build_slab(bsize)
	_build_art(bsize, font)
	_build_markers()


func _build_slab(bsize: Vector2) -> void:
	var slab := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var box := BoxMesh.new()
	box.size = Vector3(bsize.x, JunqiMap.BOARD_THICKNESS, bsize.y)
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = Color(0.404, 0.243, 0.106)
	mat.roughness = 0.62
	box.material = mat
	slab.mesh = box
	slab.position = Vector3(0.0, -JunqiMap.BOARD_THICKNESS * 0.5, 0.0)
	add_child(slab)


func _build_art(bsize: Vector2, font: Font) -> void:
	_art_view = SubViewport.new()
	_art_view.size = Vector2i(maxi(2, int(round(bsize.x * PPU))), maxi(2, int(round(bsize.y * PPU))))
	_art_view.transparent_bg = false
	_art_view.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ALWAYS
	add_child(_art_view)

	_art = BoardArt.new()
	_art.font = font
	_art.ppu = PPU
	_art.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_art_view.add_child(_art)

	var quad := MeshInstance3D.new()
	quad.mesh = MeshKit.quad_xz(bsize.x, bsize.y)
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_texture = _art_view.get_texture()
	mat.roughness = 0.58
	mat.metallic = 0.0
	mat.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	quad.material_override = mat
	quad.position = Vector3(0.0, 0.002, 0.0)
	add_child(quad)


func _build_markers() -> void:
	_sel_frame = _make_marker(MeshKit.rect_ring(FRAME_SIZE.x, FRAME_SIZE.y, 0.05), COL_GOLD, 0.018)
	_hover_frame = _make_marker(MeshKit.rect_ring(FRAME_SIZE.x, FRAME_SIZE.y, 0.025), COL_HOVER, 0.016)

	var torus := TorusMesh.new()
	torus.inner_radius = 0.14
	torus.outer_radius = 0.185
	torus.rings = 24
	torus.ring_segments = 8
	_target_mesh = torus

	_targets_root = Node3D.new()
	add_child(_targets_root)


## 生成一个“贴地发光标记”
func _make_marker(mesh: Mesh, color: Color, y: float) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.mesh = mesh
	mi.position = Vector3(0.0, y, 0.0)
	mi.material_override = _unshaded_material(color)
	mi.visible = false
	add_child(mi)
	return mi


static func _unshaded_material(color: Color) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = color
	mat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	mat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	mat.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	mat.no_depth_test = false
	return mat


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	_pulse += delta * 3.2

	# 棋盘贴图只需要渲染最初几帧，之后冻结，省下每帧的绘制开销
	if _art_view != null and _art_view.render_target_update_mode != SubViewport.UPDATE_DISABLED:
		_art_frames += 1
		if _art_frames > 3:
			_art_view.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_DISABLED

	for i in _targets.size():
		var s: float = 1.0 + 0.08 * sin(_pulse + float(i) * 0.7)
		_targets[i].scale = Vector3(s, 1.0, s)


# ==================== 提示接口（与二维版保持一致） ====================

func show_selection(pos: Vector2i) -> void:
	_sel_frame.position.x = JunqiMap.to_world(pos).x
	_sel_frame.position.z = JunqiMap.to_world(pos).z
	_sel_frame.visible = true


func hide_selection() -> void:
	if _sel_frame != null:
		_sel_frame.visible = false


## occupied: 该落点是否已有棋子（有棋子的落点把圆环抬到棋子顶上，否则贴地）
func show_targets(positions: Array, occupied: Dictionary = {}) -> void:
	clear_targets()
	for v: Variant in positions:
		if not (v is Vector2i):
			continue
		var pos: Vector2i = v
		var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
		mi.mesh = _target_mesh
		mi.material_override = _unshaded_material(COL_TARGET)
		var y: float = 0.02
		if occupied.has(pos):
			y = JunqiMap.PIECE_SIZE.y + 0.012
		var world: Vector3 = JunqiMap.to_world(pos)
		mi.position = Vector3(world.x, y, world.z)
		_targets_root.add_child(mi)

# Piece3D.gd
# 军旗翻翻棋 3D · 三维棋子
#
# 外形参照象牙白塑料棋子：圆角 + 倒角的长方体，正面象牙白、刻红 / 蓝汉字，
# 背面是深红棕色的暗棋背面（无图案），所以一眼就能看出哪些棋子还没翻开。
#   正面 = MeshKit.tile() 的表面 0（顶面与侧面）
#   背面 = MeshKit.tile() 的表面 1（底面）
# 暗棋只是把整枚棋子绕 X 轴翻 180°，翻开时再转回来，
# 字形永远朝向镜头一侧（Z+），不会出现倒置或镜像。
#
# 遵循 Godot 4.7 GDScript 2.0 静态类型规范

class_name Piece3D
extends Node3D

## 倒角高度与圆角半径（世界单位）
const BEVEL: float = 0.018
const CORNER_R: float = 0.06

static var _tile_mesh: ArrayMesh = null
static var _mat_face: StandardMaterial3D = null
static var _mat_back: StandardMaterial3D = null

## 逻辑棋子（JunqiGame.Piece）
var data: JunqiGame.Piece = null

## 摆放基础位置（格点中心 + 棋子半高），用于选中时抬升
var base_pos: Vector3 = Vector3.ZERO

var _label: Label3D = null
var _body: MeshInstance3D = null
var _sel_ring: MeshInstance3D = null
var _busy: bool = false
var _face_shown: bool = false


# ==================== 共享资源 ====================

static func _ensure_shared() -> void:
	if _tile_mesh != null:
		return
	_mat_face = StandardMaterial3D.new()
	_mat_face.albedo_color = Color(0.965, 0.945, 0.882)
	_mat_face.roughness = 0.30
	_mat_face.metallic = 0.0

	_mat_back = StandardMaterial3D.new()
	_mat_back.albedo_color = Color(0.302, 0.157, 0.118)
	_mat_back.roughness = 0.38
	_mat_back.metallic = 0.0

	_tile_mesh = MeshKit.tile(JunqiMap.PIECE_SIZE.x, JunqiMap.PIECE_SIZE.y, JunqiMap.PIECE_SIZE.z,
		BEVEL, CORNER_R)
	_tile_mesh.surface_set_material(0, _mat_face)
	_tile_mesh.surface_set_material(1, _mat_back)


# ==================== 构建 ====================

func build(p: JunqiGame.Piece, font: Font) -> void:
	data = p
	_face_shown = p.revealed
	_ensure_shared()

	_body = MeshInstance3D.new()
	_body.mesh = _tile_mesh
	add_child(_body)

	var top: float = JunqiMap.PIECE_SIZE.y * 0.5 + 0.004

	_label = Label3D.new()
	if font != null:
		_label.font = font
	_label.font_size = 50
	_label.pixel_size = 0.005
	_label.outline_size = 0
	_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_label.rotation.x = -PI * 0.5
	_label.position = Vector3(0.0, top, 0.0)
	_label.billboard = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_DISABLED
	_label.double_sided = false
	_label.shaded = false
	_label.alpha_cut = Label3D.ALPHA_CUT_DISABLED
	add_child(_label)

	_sel_ring = MeshInstance3D.new()
	_sel_ring.mesh = MeshKit.rect_ring(JunqiMap.PIECE_SIZE.x * 0.94, JunqiMap.PIECE_SIZE.z * 0.94, 0.03)
	_sel_ring.position = Vector3(0.0, top - 0.001, 0.0)
	_sel_ring.material_override = Board3D._unshaded_material(Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.36))
	_sel_ring.visible = false
	add_child(_sel_ring)

	# 暗棋：整枚棋子翻过来（背面朝上）
	rotation.x = 0.0 if p.revealed else PI
	_apply_face()


# ==================== 外观 ====================

func _apply_face() -> void:
	if data == null or _label == null:
		return
	if data.revealed:
		_label.text = data.display_name()
		_label.modulate = JunqiData.SIDE_TEXT[data.side]
		_label.visible = true
	else:
		_label.text = ""
		_label.visible = false


# ==================== 动画 ====================

## 翻面动画：抬起 + 绕 X 轴转 180°，转到一半时文字已经朝上
func reveal(animated: bool = true) -> void:
	if _face_shown:
		_apply_face()
		return
	_face_shown = true
	if not animated or not is_inside_tree():
		rotation.x = 0.0
		position.y = base_pos.y
		_apply_face()
		return

	_busy = true
	_apply_face()

	var lift := create_tween()
	lift.tween_property(self, "position:y", base_pos.y + 0.22, 0.16) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	lift.tween_property(self, "position:y", base_pos.y, 0.20) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)

	var flip := create_tween()
	flip.tween_property(self, "rotation:x", 0.0, 0.34) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	await flip.finished

	rotation.x = 0.0
	position = base_pos
	_busy = false


## 移动动画（带小跳跃）
func animate_move(target: Vector3, duration: float = 0.34) -> void:
	base_pos = target
	if not is_inside_tree():
		position = target
		return
	_busy = true

	var move := create_tween()
	move.set_parallel(true)
	move.tween_property(self, "position:x", target.x, duration) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)
	move.tween_property(self, "position:z", target.z, duration) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)

	var hop := create_tween()
	hop.tween_property(self, "position:y", target.y + 0.30, duration * 0.5) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	hop.tween_property(self, "position:y", target.y, duration * 0.5) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)

	await move.finished
	position = target
	rotation.x = 0.0
	_busy = false


## 阵亡动画：缩小 + 旋转 + 沉入棋盘
func animate_destroy() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		queue_free()
		return
	_busy = true
	if _sel_ring != null:
		_sel_ring.visible = false
	var tween := create_tween()
	tween.set_parallel(true)
	tween.tween_property(self, "scale", Vector3.ONE * 0.05, 0.26) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)
	tween.tween_property(self, "position:y", base_pos.y - 0.30, 0.26) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)
	tween.tween_property(self, "rotation:y", rotation.y + PI * 1.2, 0.26)
	await tween.finished
	queue_free()


## 被选中时轻微抬起，并亮起金色描边
func set_selected(value: bool) -> void:
	if _sel_ring != null:
		_sel_ring.visible = value
	if _busy:
		return
	var target_y: float = base_pos.y + 0.13 if value else base_pos.y
	var tween := create_tween()
	tween.tween_property(self, "position:y", target_y, 0.13) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE)
